name: Mycelium Network
description: Growing network patterns resembling fungal mycelium with diffusion-limited aggregation branching and bioluminescent tips Batch 38 FAST MOTION upgrade: bioluminescent signal pulses race along the hyphae (closed-form traveling wave), the growth front uses fast-in/smooth-out time-warp easing, bass transients fire expanding spore-burst shockwaves via a frame-rate-independent rising-edge detector (persistent state in extraBuffer[133..135]), and the branch traversal is coarse-culled with bounding-box pruning before every segment SDF evaluation. Feedback accumulation is HDR-clamped (<=4.0) so growth can never saturate the screen.
